name: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16G SHADOW 3X OC Graphics Card
shortDescription: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16G SHADOW 3X OC Graphics Card (16GB GDDR7 256-bit / NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture / DLSS 4.5 & Ray Tracing / Factory Overclocked / TORX Fan 5.0 Triple Cooling / PCIe 5.0 / DisplayPort 2.1b &a
descriptionHtml:
MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16G SHADOW 3X OC Graphics Card (16GB GDDR7 256-bit / NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture / DLSS 4.5 & Ray Tracing / Factory Overclocked / TORX Fan 5.0 Triple Cooling / PCIe 5.0 / DisplayPort 2.1b & HDMI 2.1b / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience next-generation gaming performance and AI-accelerated workflows with the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 16G SHADOW 3X OC graphics card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Powered by the revolutionary NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and featuring 16GB of high-speed GDDR7 memory, this card is engineered for ultra-high frame rates, full ray tracing, and DLSS 4.5 technologies. Equipped with a robust triple-fan thermal solution featuring TORX Fan 5.0, square Core Pipes, a nickel-plated copper baseplate, and a reinforcing backplate, it delivers cool and quiet operation under heavy gaming loads.
